name: Interactive Data Grid
summary: Sortable, filterable, searchable grid (Tabulator 6) for appendix-style detail data, with frozen columns, grouped headers, paging and CSV download.
summary_zh: 可排序、可筛选、可搜索的明细数据表（Tabulator 6），支持冻结列、分组表头、分页 / 虚拟滚动和 CSV 下载。
description_zh: 用于附录或明细页：列默认取自数据集 schema（标题、RK 格式码，数字右对齐），也可用 columns 指定顺序、分组表头与宽度。每列表头带筛选框（文本为包含匹配，数字支持“>10”“<=2.5”“5-10”“30%”），顶部有全局搜索和 CSV 下载，固定高度内虚拟滚动或按页显示。点击行会按 key 字段交叉筛选其他图表，全局筛选变化时以 replaceData 平滑刷新并保留排序与筛选；适合 20–5,000 行的交易清单、可比公司全表等。
best_for: Full precedent-transaction or peer lists in an appendix
Detail data behind a chart that clients want to search and download
Long lists (hundreds to thousands of rows) with paging or virtual scroll
avoid_when: A formatted pitchbook comps page with statistic rows (use comps-table)
Fewer than ~8 rows (a plain table reads better)

key.desc: Cross-filter / row identity field (defaults to the first text field)

highlight.desc: Boolean flag marking rows to highlight (e.g. is_target)

columns.desc: [{field, title?, format?, group?, width?, minWidth?, align?, sign?, headerFilter?}] or field names; null = every schema field

hidden.desc: Fields left out when columns is null

frozen.desc: Number of leading columns frozen during horizontal scroll

headerFilters.desc: Per-column filter inputs (text contains; numbers >, <, =, a-b, %)

search.desc: Global search box over all columns (raw and formatted values)

searchFilters.desc: Also publish the search text as a global filter so other blocks on the same dataset follow

download.desc: CSV download button (filtered rows, raw values, UTF-8 BOM)

pagination.desc: false = virtual scroll inside the block height; a number = rows per page

highlight.desc: Key value(s) to highlight in addition to encode.highlight

crossFilter.desc: Click a row to cross-filter other blocks on the key field
